about_the_game:
trapped in many mysterious liminal spaces the only way back to where you came from is to move forward and hope you find an exit, Along the way discover a possible government organization that made this place and many more secrets hidden in the liminal spaces

The Liminal Library includes a mixture of level exploration, puzzle solving, and unique odd rules the player must follow through each level. Along with all game play features there are also multiple story lines that can be uncovered by the player throughout playing the game

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Graphics: DirectX 12 compatible graphics card
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel i7 / AMD Ryzen 7 or better
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2080 / AMD RX 6800 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 16 GB available space

short_description: The Liminal Library is a horror game based on liminal spaces where players solve puzzles, uncover many things hidden within the liminal spaces. The Liminal Library works on exploration as well as puzzles based mechanics to find your way out along with other rules you must follow for survival.
